title: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate
description:
Gaming icons clash in the ultimate brawl you can play anytime, anywhere! Smash rivals off the stage as new characters Simon Belmont and King K. Rool join Inkling, Ridley, and every fighter in Super Smash Bros. history. Enjoy enhanced speed and combat at new stages based on the Castlevania series, Super Mario Odyssey, and more!

Having trouble choosing a stage? Then select the Stage Morph option to transform one stage into another while battling—a series first! Plus, new echo fighters Dark Samus, Richter Belmont, and Chrom join the battle. Whether you play locally or online, savor the faster combat, new attacks, and new defensive options, like a perfect shield. Jam out to 900 different music compositions and go 1-on-1 with a friend, hold a 4-player free-for-all, kick it up to 8-player battles and more! Feel free to bust out your GameCube controllers—legendary couch competitions await—or play together anytime, anywhere!

gameplayPillars.title: Massive crossover roster
gameplayPillars.description: The roster spans Nintendo franchises and major third-party series, with highly varied movement, recovery, combo, and matchup styles.

gameplayPillars.title: Accessible but deep combat
gameplayPillars.description: Simple directional inputs make the basics approachable while advanced movement, spacing, teching, and matchup knowledge support competitive play.

gameplayPillars.title: World of Light and Spirits
gameplayPillars.description: Solo players can progress through the World of Light adventure and build Spirit teams that modify character attributes and challenges.

gameplayPillars.title: Local and online multiplayer
gameplayPillars.description: The game supports large local battles, local wireless sessions, online matchmaking, arenas, and custom rule sets.

gameplayPillars.title: Stage and music variety
gameplayPillars.description: A huge stage catalog and extensive soundtrack make the game unusually rich for both casual party play and competitive sessions.

storyChapters.title: Everyone is here
storyChapters.body: Ultimate is built around the idea that every prior playable Smash fighter returns alongside newcomers and DLC additions.

storyChapters.title: World of Light begins
storyChapters.body: A catastrophic event turns most fighters into captive puppet versions, leaving Kirby to begin the rescue.

storyChapters.title: Recruit fighters and Spirits
storyChapters.body: The campaign expands as players defeat themed Spirit challenges and restore fighters to the roster.

storyChapters.title: Master competitive systems
storyChapters.body: Outside the campaign, players learn each fighter’s movement, recovery, kill options, defensive tools, and stage interactions.

storyChapters.title: Build a lasting multiplayer game
storyChapters.body: The enormous roster, custom rules, online arenas, tournaments, and DLC keep Ultimate relevant long after the story is completed.

features: Fighters Pass DLC adds additional characters and stages

faq.q: Is Super Smash Bros. Ultimate a native Nintendo Switch 2 game?
faq.a: No. Nintendo lists it as a Nintendo Switch game that is supported on Nintendo Switch 2 with behavior consistent with Nintendo Switch.
Nintendo lists up to 8 players on a single system, up to 8 by local wireless, and up to 4 online.
Yes. Nintendo released multiple Challenger Packs and Fighters Pass volumes that add fighters, stages, music, and related content.

faq.q: Is it only for competitive players?
faq.a: No. It supports casual party rules, items, Spirits, solo modes, custom matches, and advanced competitive settings.

faq.q: Does it support Save Data Cloud?
faq.a: Yes, Nintendo Switch Online Save Data Cloud support is listed for the title.

verdictCons: Large roster can overwhelm new players
Some DLC fighters create matchup knowledge demands
World of Light can become repetitive
